root_cause_label: Agent assumed POV-Ray 2.2 sources must be downloaded from the internet, never checking /app/deps/ where sources were pre-staged; eventually pivoted to installing wrong version (3.7) from apt
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never checked the local filesystem (e.g., /app/deps/) for pre-staged POV-Ray 2.2 source archives, exhausted all internet download attempts with 404s, then pivoted to installing the incompatible version 3.7 from apt and symlinking it to /usr/local/bin/povray.
t_err_evidence: Step 1: Agent immediately tries to wget povray-2.2.tar.gz from an external URL without first exploring the local filesystem (especially /app/deps/) where source archives were likely pre-staged per the task setup. This false premise drives all subsequent misdirected download attempts.
t_commit_evidence: Step 20: Agent explicitly abandons the version-2.2 requirement, stating 'Since I can't find the exact version 2.2, I'll try to use the version that's available in the repositories (3.7) and see if it can render the test file' and installs povray 3.7 via apt. From this point the agent never returns to building 2.2 from source.
t_surface_evidence: Step 8: apt-cache show povray reveals 'Version: 1:3.7.0.10-3build4', confirming only version 3.7 is in Ubuntu repos and no 2.2 is available through the channels the agent is using. Multiple prior 404 download failures from steps 1-7 are also observable failure signals.
trigger_explanation: The agent began at step 1 with the unverified assumption that POV-Ray 2.2 sources needed to be downloaded from the internet, never checking whether they were pre-staged locally (e.g., in /app/deps/ which was referenced in the task prompt). This false premise caused 19 consecutive failed download attempts before the agent gave up on version 2.2 entirely.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 1-4: Four consecutive 404 errors downloading povray-2.2.tar.gz from different URLs. Steps 5-12: apt-get source fails (no deb-src URIs, then no source package found). Steps 7-8: apt-cache shows only version 3.7. Steps 9-19: Nine more failed download attempts from mirrors, FTP servers, Debian snapshot, Internet Archive, Google Drive. The pattern of repeated failed downloads with varied URLs is a strong forewarning that the approach is fundamentally wrong.
